digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm.criteria — review-policy snapshots and overlay validation
propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria and routing through multiple seams, causing code-review project disables to be ignored, activated project DET criteria to disappear, and separate reads to describe different repository policy states.

A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must compile effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, routing metadata, and source locations with one deterministic digest before any selection or model invocation.

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative globs, with ["**"] representing repository-wide unconditional selection (preserving prior ungated behavior for empty changed-files).

The stricter non-empty-glob rule applies only to code-review project LLM criteria at snapshot compile time; plan-review project criteria and other gates remain unaffected by the shared _validate_applies_to validator.

Contract tests must verify snapshot immutability, effective policy presence, source provenance, correct glob matching including the empty-changed-files edge case, and that applies_to:["**"] migration from [] is behavior-preserving.
